title: Candidate Work Stub
description: Canonical stub for one unit of candidate work surfaced by a discovery generator (bug-scrub, improve-harness, explore-feature). Carries enough provenance, sizing, and framing for prioritize-proposals to rank it and scaffold an OpenSpec change from it. This is the single agreed shape the generators emit (migration tracked separately); consumers validate against it before ranking.

title.description: Short human-readable name for the candidate work item.

description.description: What the work entails — the concrete change or capability proposed.

rationale.description: Why this work is worth doing — the evidence or motivation behind the candidate.

provenance.description: Traceability back to the discovery artifact and findings that surfaced this candidate.

source_artifact.description: Repo-relative path (or URI) to the artifact that produced this candidate, e.g. a bug-scrub report or explore-feature opportunities.json.

finding_ids.description: Identifiers of the originating findings within source_artifact (e.g. 'marker-TODO-src/auth.py:42'). May be empty when the artifact has no finding-level granularity.

generator.description: Which discovery generator emitted this candidate.

effort.description: Estimated implementation effort. Aligned with roadmap.schema.json item effort.

priority.description: Priority estimate (1 = highest). A relative ordering hint the consumer may re-rank.

suggested_change_id.description: Proposed OpenSpec change-id, prefixed with add-/update-/remove-/refactor- per repo convention.

depends_on.description: Optional change-ids or candidate identifiers that must land before this one.

tags.description: Optional free-form classification tags (e.g. bucket labels, lenses).
